items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: when I played my very first big recital with the organist... I said, “Schuyler,” you know, and he was a very, the organist really helped me with that too.

ctx.x: The last couple of them right there is probably — and then of course when I played my very first big recital with the organist, I got there and I looked out and it was in the big concert hall. I was expecting the usual, you know, 50 people. There were like 500. And it was so exciting to see all these people. And I was a little nervous for that but at the same time I was going wow, this is great, you know, look it. I said, “Schuyler,” you know, and he was a very, the organist really helped me with that too.…

everybody else had so much training and I was self-trained almost. And my trumpet teacher was absolutely wonderful. He understood where I was, just like my band director did. He was great. So I’ve always lacked confidence even though I was first trumpet in the jazz band, you know I played first in the second orchestra, I played in the best brass quintet, but I didn’t have the confidence that should go with that you know. So when I finally realized that I could play some, it was great you know. And I had moments…
